reason: A final source review found that activation stripped inherited GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT without restoring them. Fixed explicit public values and a conflicting-parent negative test were added. This changes activation and its fixture/supervisor/finalizer bootstrap chain, so the earlier passing suite and plan/freeze remain retained historical preparation and do not validate the final source. Current reproduction scripts target a distinct revision l/runtime b snapshot after the final suite.
